title: Pharma Research & Clinical Trial Monitor Input
description: Pull PubMed papers and ClinicalTrials.gov studies at scale. Mix queries, PMIDs, and NCT IDs in one run. Each record ships as a normalized row with optional citation enrichment.

pubmedQueries.title: PubMed search queries
pubmedQueries.description: Free text or PubMed Entrez queries. Supports MeSH and field tags: "breast cancer"[MeSH], pembrolizumab[Title], 2024[PDAT]. Example: ["GLP-1 receptor agonist obesity", "CRISPR sickle cell"].
pubmedQueries.sectionDescription: Provide at least one of: pubmedQueries, clinicalTrialsQueries, pmids, or nctIds.

clinicalTrialsQueries.title: ClinicalTrials.gov search queries
clinicalTrialsQueries.description: Free text queries against ClinicalTrials.gov. Matches title, conditions, interventions, and sponsor fields. Example: ["alzheimer monoclonal antibody", "pediatric ADHD"].

pmids.title: Direct PubMed IDs
pmids.description: PMIDs to fetch directly. Skips search, enriches each one with full abstract, authors, MeSH terms, and references. Example: ["38523054", "39122189"].

nctIds.title: Direct NCT IDs
nctIds.description: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT numbers to fetch directly. Example: ["NCT05123456", "NCT04999111"].

dateFrom.title: Published or updated from
dateFrom.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). For PubMed: publication date lower bound. For ClinicalTrials.gov: lastUpdatePostDate lower bound. Empty means no bound.
dateFrom.sectionDescription: All filters apply to query searches. Direct PMID and NCT ID lookups return everything.

dateTo.title: Published or updated until
dateTo.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Upper bound. Empty means no bound.

publicationTypes.title: PubMed publication types
publicationTypes.description: Restrict PubMed to specific publication types. Common: Clinical Trial, Randomized Controlled Trial, Meta-Analysis, Systematic Review, Review.

studyStatus.title: ClinicalTrials.gov status filter
studyStatus.description: Restrict trials to specific recruitment statuses. Empty means all statuses.

phases.title: Trial phases
phases.description: Restrict trials to specific phases. Empty means all phases.

studyTypes.title: Trial study types
studyTypes.description: Restrict trials to specific study types. Empty means all study types.

fetchAbstracts.title: Include full abstracts
fetchAbstracts.description: Include the full abstract text in each PubMed row. Adds one extra efetch call per query batch. On by default since abstracts are the most valuable field.
fetchAbstracts.sectionDescription: Each enrichment toggle adds requests. Use with maxRecords to bound cost.

fetchMeshTerms.title: Include MeSH terms
fetchMeshTerms.description: Parse Medical Subject Heading terms from the PubMed XML record. Useful for topic clustering and indexing.

fetchReferences.title: Include references and cited by
fetchReferences.description: For each PubMed paper, pull the reference list and citing PMIDs from NCBI ELink. Adds two extra requests per paper. Best with maxRecords <= 500.

fetchTrialResults.title: Include trial results when available
fetchTrialResults.description: Include posted results (primary outcomes, adverse events) for completed trials. Only ~30% of trials post results. Adds the resultsSection field per row.

maxRecords.title: Max records per run
maxRecords.description: Hard cap on total rows pushed (PubMed papers + clinical trials combined). 0 means unlimited.

maxPerQuery.title: Max records per query
maxPerQuery.description: Cap per individual query before moving to the next. Stops one broad query from eating the entire budget.

ncbiApiKey.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbiApiKey.description: Free NCBI API key from https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account. Without a key: 3 PubMed requests per second. With a key: 10 per second. Recommended for runs over 500 records.

email.title: Contact email (optional)
email.description: NCBI requests an identifying email for E-utilities calls. Used in the User-Agent. No marketing.

dedupe.title: Deduplicate across runs
dedupe.description: Skip PMIDs and NCT IDs already pushed in previous runs. Use for daily incremental scrapes. Turn off to refresh stale rows. Off by default so a repeated query returns its full result set. Turn it on to poll for new items only.

navigationDelayMs.title: Delay between requests (ms)
navigationDelayMs.description: Pause between API calls. NCBI rate limits at 3 per second without a key. Default of 350 ms keeps you well under the limit.
